description: Chaos Commerce checkout: prices the cart with absurd fees, argues with a payment gateway that always gives in (max 4 attempts), packs the parcels and confirms the order. Always completes.
name: chaos_checkout

description: Chaos Commerce returns: checks eligibility, runs 7 pointless checks that affect nothing, waits 4 seconds for a manager who never answers, then always issues a decision (APPROVED, STORE_CREDIT or DENIED).
